input.body:
label: bug
file: src/components/ExportButton.tsx

The `handleClick` handler in `ExportButton` only calls `setBusy(false)` inside the `.then()` of `exportReport(...)`. Since `exportReport` rejects (throws) when the response is not OK, a failed export never reaches that line, leaving `busy` stuck at `true` and the button/select permanently disabled until a full page reload. Fixing this means adding a `.catch()` (or try/finally with async/await) that resets `busy` to `false` and surfaces an error toast when the export promise rejects.

input.title: Reset export button state after a failed export
input.body: File: src/components/ExportButton.tsx. In handleClick, the call to exportReport only resets busy to false in the success .then() callback; if the returned promise rejects (e.g. a non-2xx response throws in exportReport), setBusy(false) is never called and the button stays disabled until the page reloads. Add a .catch() (or try/catch with async/await) that resets busy to false and shows an error toast on failure, so the button becomes clickable again after a failed export.
